turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got to give them two references, and I'm not sure which people to pick.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hear me out on all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My old team leader from the warehouse, who loved me but that was five years ago.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My current manager, who's fine, but I haven't told her I'm looking yet.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A client I worked closely with for two years who always says I'm brilliant.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or my college tutor, who knows me well but only from studying.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all of them. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd go with the client and the old team leader for now. Ask the company to contact your current manager only after an offer, that's a very normal request. Your tutor is better for a first job than for this one.
